metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Session History (v1.3)
metadata.subtitle: Chronological Narrative of RTT • Regime • Measures • Paradox • Consent
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative historical narrative for FFT AI Edition v1.3 sessions.

status_line: History is a projection only; authoritative values come from session.state, alignments, context, and log.

field_definitions.timestamp: ISO timestamp of the historical event.
field_definitions.paradox_events: List of typed paradox events or empty list.
field_definitions.collapse_state: null unless RTT12; MUST be 'collapsed' at RTT12.

projection_rules: History MUST NOT contradict authoritative session.state.json.
History MUST NOT invent measure values.
History MUST NOT invent paradox types.
History MUST NOT invent substrate classes.
rtt_rules: rtt_node MUST be one of RTT1–RTT12.
RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
regime_rules: Regime MUST be nominal, harmonic, or resolution.
Regime MUST match rtt_node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.
substrate_rules: Non-agentic substrate forbidden for harmonic and resolution.
